source: Blues chords sit on the first, fourth and fifth notes of the key. In E that's E7, A7 and B7. Move to the key of A and they become A7, D7 and E7.
old: Blūza akordi balstās uz tonalitātes pirmās, ceturtās un piektās pakāpes. E tonalitātē tie ir E7, A7 un B7. A tonalitātē tie kļūst par A7, D7 un E7.
new: Blūza akordu pamattoņi ir tonalitātes pirmā, ceturtā un piektā pakāpe. E tonalitātē tie ir E7, A7 un B7. A tonalitātē tie kļūst par A7, D7 un E7.
reason: Full explanatory context U0296 read. Replace grammatically malformed balstās uz ... pakāpes with an explicit root/scale-degree construction; preserve degree sequence and all chord symbols.
withdrawal_reason: Second grammatical pass: uz can govern genitive for location in Latvian; distributive singular pakāpes is not enough evidence of an error. The frozen author translation preserves all source scale degrees and chord symbols; avoid an unnecessary rewrite.
